editorial.blurb: Maharaj Indian Grill serves some of the best Indian cuisine in the area, with fresh, flavorful dishes and genuinely attentive service that keeps diners coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Vegan Lunch Express Combo for an incredibly fresh and reasonably priced option, and ask for the mango lassi served in their signature cute boot glass.

topDishes.note: Fresh, flavorful, and perfectly prepared with generous portions
Incredibly refreshing, comes in a charming boot glass
